input.summary: From the right flipper, collect needed roto-target grid positions. From the left, use the upper-right gate to spin the wheel and reach the top lanes. At a near-full grid, switch to drops and build the 10X, 20,000 bonus collect.

quickInfo.name: Roto grid
quickInfo.summary: The wheel exposes A, B, and C targets numbered 1 through 3; the center B2 position starts spotted.

quickInfo.name: Multiplier patterns
quickInfo.summary: A diagonal gives 2X, a three-position line gives 3X or 4X, the four corners give 5X, and all nine positions give 10X.

quickInfo.name: Wheel advance
quickInfo.summary: Any of six lanes, the upper-right gate, or the bullseye below it rotates the exposed target numbers.

quickInfo.name: Drop banks
quickInfo.summary: The left bank spots A1 and C3 while the right bank spots A3 and C1, so completing both guarantees the four-corner 5X pattern.

quickInfo.name: 10X collect
quickInfo.summary: At a full grid and 20,000 base bonus, the upper-right gate collects bonus, resets the base, and keeps 10X for the rest of the ball.

steps.text: Plunge for one of the two left top lanes because gate shots more often feed the right pair.
Read the 3-by-3 grid and the three numbers currently exposed on the roto target.
From the right flipper, shoot an exposed A, B, or C target only when that position is unlit.
From the left flipper, shoot the upper-right gate to rotate the wheel and reach the top lanes.
Alternate roto hits and gate shots until the grid is nearly full.
If an exposed roto position completes an early 2X diagonal, 3X A-B-C line, or 4X same-position line, collect it before continuing toward the full grid.
Use the left and right drop banks to spot missing corner pairs and build base bonus.
After all nine grid positions are lit, continue drop targets until base bonus reaches 20,000.
Shoot the upper-right gate to collect 20,000 at 10X, then keep shooting targets while 10X remains.

fallback.title: Two-bank corner route
fallback.when: Use this plan when the roto target is difficult to read or hit accurately.

steps.text: Complete the left five-bank to spot A1 and C3.
Complete the right bank to spot A3 and C1.
Take the guaranteed four-corner 5X multiplier.
Use lanes and the gate to rotate the wheel before trying only clearly missing grid positions.

alternatives.title: Lit drop-target scoring
alternatives.when: Use this plan after a left or right top-lane pair lights its matching drop bank.

steps.text: Confirm the matching bank is lit for increased target value.
Choose a target that also adds base bonus or completes its bank.
Stop after an unsafe side-to-side rebound.
Return to the gate and roto sequence.
Fill all nine roto-grid positions during one ball.
Build base bonus to 20,000 with lanes, bullseye, and drop targets.
Collect 200,000 through the upper-right gate at 10X.
Keep the 10X multiplier for the rest of the ball while base bonus resets.
Rebuild base bonus with target shots and collect again if the gate condition relights.

techniques.name: Right-flipper roto shot
techniques.instruction: Read the exposed A, B, and C numbers before cradling on the right. Shoot only an unlit grid position.

techniques.name: Left-flipper gate shot
techniques.instruction: Use the left flipper for the upper-right gate. The shot rotates the wheel and is the safest route to the top lanes.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Judge the ball's speed before a lower post contact. Nudge only when the rebound can reach the return lane instead of the outlane.

cautions.issue: The exposed bumpers can send the ball to a drain or sling.
cautions.response: Prefer the gate and controlled roto shots. Track every upper-playfield exit until the ball reaches a flipper.

cautions.issue: Drop-bank rebounds create dangerous side-to-side action.
cautions.response: Use the banks for corner spots, lit target value, and base bonus, then stop after a rebound reaches a sling.

cautions.issue: A ball can roll up and out behind either flipper.
cautions.response: Do not hold a flipper up under a fast lateral feed. Drop the flipper before the ball climbs past the heel.

cautions.issue: Grid, base bonus, and multiplier reset each ball.
cautions.response: Commit to the 10X collect only when the current ball has enough grid and bonus progress; do not plan on carrying partial work.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Torch instruction card, ball count, and award settings.
Test roto alignment, upper gate, posts, and target values.

input.simpleOverview: Torch records nine roto-target positions in a grid and turns completed patterns into Bonus X. Use the right flipper for needed grid positions, rotate the wheel from the left, and complete the four corners before attempting the full grid and upper-right bonus collect.
input.overview: Torch records nine roto-target positions in a grid and turns completed patterns into Bonus X. Use controlled roto shots for missing positions and the two banks for the four corners, then fill all nine positions and build 20,000 base bonus. Shoot the upper-right gate to collect 200,000 and rebuild while 10x remains active.
